closureRequirements: Actual pre-dispatch hook coverage for the exact tool path.
Same-session denial of an unmanaged probe and permission of a declared read-only probe.
Exact activation, session, workspace, adapter, daemon, policy, authority, and time identities.
Dispatch restricted to the admitted capability and mechanic.
Authenticated operator control that cannot be supplied by the agent.
Execution testimony binding the actual effect and outcome to its decision.
Fail-closed handling of uncovered paths, malformed requests, identity drift, and unavailable adjudication.
